data_fields.name: spawn_interval
data_fields.donor_constant: 350 default turns (DEFAULTGENERATESPEED), scaled by score ratio

data_fields.name: interval_score_ratio
data_fields.donor_constant: max_manage_score * generate_speed / own manage_score; generate_speed when own score is 0 or less

data_fields.name: excess_weight_rank_divisor
data_fields.donor_constant: divide by (rank + 1): 1, 2, 3 for first, second, third entrance room

data_fields.name: kind_pool_count
data_fields.donor_constant: no default in code read; set by level script via add_creature_to_pool

data_fields.name: kind_required_slabs
data_fields.donor_constant: per kind from config (entrance_slabs_req); default 0 at init

data_fields.name: attraction_per_slabs_entrance_rooms
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per 3 slabs, minus owned of this kind

data_fields.name: attraction_per_slabs_heart_bridge
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per 9 slabs, minus owned of this kind

data_fields.name: attraction_per_slabs_workshop_garden
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per 4 slabs, minus owned of this kind

data_fields.name: kind_gold_pay
data_fields.donor_constant: per kind config (pay); gate only, no deduction in the function read

data_fields.name: lair_free_space_gate
data_fields.donor_constant: generate when free space >= 0 (one over-capacity arrival allowed at 0)

data_fields.name: mood_penalty_on_zone_score
data_fields.donor_constant: up to one half (raw/2 base plus mood term)

best_idea: A zone spawn director: a finite per-kind pool, a population cap, a presence gate on required room slabs, one seeded weighted roll per attempt, and a fixed-step attempt clock whose interval scales with how well the zone is run.
decision_why: Cap, finite pool, presence gate, one weighted roll and a per-zone clock fit parity row 23 as zone data; the gold, lair, room-role and manage-score inputs are Dungeon Keeper economy and must become zone-defined fields, and the clock runs on the server fixed step.
acceptance: Server test: a zone with cap 3, a 30 s interval and a pool of 2 goblins spawns exactly 2 and never exceeds 3 live; an attempt made while the cap is full still restarts the clock; the pool drops by one per spawn and never on a refused attempt.
